name: Men's USAF-style mess dress: officer sleeve braid overlay (1/2 in, 3 in from the sleeve end)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-male. Braid 0.5 in wide, its edge nearest the sleeve end 3 in from the sleeve end (cut parallel to the cuff) per CAPR 39-1 4.1.1.1; general officers wear 1 1/2 in (separate overlay). Braid tone: sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x, Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6 against coat 0,40,101 (the figures draw a tonal braid, ~0.72x the coat luminance); drawn in the figure's line structure, 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, but lighter than the figure: the tonal band repeats C/Col Doran's "too close to the jacket colour" (mess dress braid #0b1f5e, 1.1x the coat luminance, 2026-10-12) and the flat #2149a0 (5.3x) was "too light" (2026-10-14), so lines #1e3c82 (3.6x), gaps #12286a (1.9x), edge #0a1740 on the coat #001c52, band mean 2.5x, the geometric mean of the two rated values.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)
documented: 1/2 in blue sleeve braid 3 in from the end of the sleeve, all officers except generals (4.1.1.1)
assumed: braid colour: not specified as a shade; lighter blue from the dress's satin shawl collar so it can be seen on the coat, Doran D37 (see base-art/braid-art.js)
